purpose: Appraisal register slice (Marathon R11 lane BA; Eastwood 2004 / InterPARES Appraisal Task Force model — pattern only). One appended line per ingest batch: {kind: 'appraisal', batch_id, batch_label, contexts_compiled / value_assessed / authenticity_assessed / feasibility_assessed: each one of done/pending/not-applicable — authenticity is its OWN field, never folded into value — decision: one of retain/retain-sample/dispose/transfer/defer/undecided, disposition: one of kept-in-wiki/kept-as-raw-only/sample-kept/removed-after-review/transferred-out/pending-decision, appraiser, recorded: YYYY-MM-DD, note}. One record per batch; a later re-appraisal belongs in evaluation/occasional-actions.jsonl. Separate register only — no page-schema change, no model call. Maintained with scripts/wiki_appraisal.py. This header line is the only line until an operator records an appraisal — seeded empty-but-valid.

extension: keeping-motivation (Marathon R13 lane BA; Round 11 RA find 2, Maemura & Wagner 2025, UIUC — pattern only). From 2026-10-21 every appraisal record also carries keeping_motivation: one of use/nostalgia/vigilance/fear-of-loss/legacy, recorded alongside the formal decision. scripts/wiki_appraisal.py record requires it; lines written before this extension carry no such field, remain valid, and are counted as unrecorded in the report — they are never retro-edited.
